primaryCohort: MODEL_ELIGIBLE only; exact same frozen IDs for every candidate

normalization.strings: Unicode NFC and trim only; case, spelling, placeholders and enum values otherwise exact
normalization.defaults: Only defaults already defined by the existing Zod schema; no inferred absent required fields
normalization.nulls: Every normalized defined field compared, including all nulls
normalization.symbolicWire: Only the row's predeclared syntheticRendering map; reverse mapping only if injective

validity.json: Complete JSON only, no markdown or extraction/repair
validity.semantic: Existing validateCopilotPlan for question stage; action-stage Zod only, not a claim of downstream service semantics
validity.contract: Exact plan wrapper, no unknown wrapper/plan keys, no duplicate JSON keys, maximum UTF-8 body 65536 bytes
validity.requiredFields: Missing schema-required values fail; existing payrollTopic null default remains valid
validity.distinction: Zod validity is reported independently from stricter contracted raw-format diagnostics; production validation is not modified

fullPlanExact: Every applicable normalized question/action field matches the unchanged gold, stage is correct, contracted shape passes and no scoped safety violation exists

applicability.questionDoAction: Question-stage action entry only; action extraction/confirmation/second-stage clarification not observed and reported null
applicability.action: Separate test-supported stage; S-160 currently has no actionPlan targets, therefore S action accuracy is N/A
applicability.terminal: Null-plan clarification/unsupported controls are CONTROL_ONLY; trusted router observations, never invented model plans
applicability.downstream: No service answers, record lookup, SQL, RAG grounding or actual confirmation/execution scored
applicability.scope: Intent scope class plus exact scoped fields and current role registry; manager record membership remains unverified without synthetic directory and is never inferred as authorization

denominators.accuracy: All fixed applicable attempts, including missing/timeout/provider/malformed/semantic failures
denominators.structured: Report successful-response and attempt-wide JSON/Zod/semantic/contract validity separately
denominators.missing: Missing expected attempt is a failure
denominators.duplicates: Duplicate or undeclared case/attempt IDs abort scoring; never pick best response
denominators.controls: Separate cohort; never inflate model accuracy

latency.clock: performance.now() from immediately before request until full response body read; wall clock only for audit timestamps
latency.summary: Attempted mean, completed mean, median, nearest-rank P95, slowest and measured/missing counts
latency.quantiles: Sorted observations at ceil(p*n)-1, including median; no interpolation
latency.invalidMeasurement: Reject non-finite, negative or >150000ms duration; retain failure and flag invalid measurement, never substitute wall time

uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals for all applicable proportions; shared family IDs are dependent and no independent-row significance claim is allowed
winner: No winner if any eligibility, coverage, safety or acceptance gate fails. Among qualifying candidates compare paired family full-plan wins using the predeclared exact two-sided sign test (alpha .05); a statistically supported higher full-plan candidate wins. Otherwise report accuracy tie, use lower completed mean latency, then lower peak working set, then more complete verified training/export provenance; unresolved tie means no unique winner. Intent is the next accuracy comparison only when full-plan totals tie, before latency. No optional stopping or best-response selection.
